# UAE Extension

UAE succession law — dual-track (Sharia default vs DIFC common law), DWSC registered wills, expatriate handling under Federal Decree-Law No. 41/2022; includes ADGM wills service, non-Muslim court registration, UAE real property treatment, and dual-track dispute resolution (Sharia vs common law)

Source: [`v3/extensions/uae/uae.json`](../../../../v3/extensions/uae/uae.json)

Schema `$id`: `https://openinherit.org/v3/extensions/uae/uae.json`

## Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `successionTrack` | one of `sharia`, `difc`, `decree_law_41_home_country` | yes | Which succession track applies — Sharia (default for Muslims) or DIFC (opted-in for non-Muslims) |
| `difcWill` | `object` | | DIFC Wills and Probate Registry details |
| `emirate` | one of `abu_dhabi`, `dubai`, `sharjah`, `ajman`, `umm_al_quwain`, `ras_al_khaimah`, `fujairah` | | Which emirate the estate is primarily administered in — different emirates have different courts |
| `expatriateHandling` | `object` | | Under Federal Decree-Law No. 41/2022, non-Muslim expatriates may elect home country law |
| `freeZoneAssets` | array of `object` | | Assets held in UAE free zones may have different treatment |
| `shariaFixedShares` | `object` | | Sharia fixed-share (fara'id) application under UAE Personal Status Law (Federal Law No. 28/2005) |
| `adgmWill` | `object` | | Abu Dhabi Global Market (ADGM) Wills Service — alternative to DIFC for Abu Dhabi residents |
| `nonMuslimWillRegistration` | `object` | | Non-Muslim will registration with local courts (Dubai Courts, Abu Dhabi Judicial Department) |
| `propertyTreatment` | `object` | | UAE real property treatment — freehold only available to foreigners in designated areas |
| `disputeResolution` | `object` | | Inheritance dispute resolution forum — dual-track system (Sharia vs common law) |
| `homeCountryLawElection` | `object` | | Election to apply home-country succession law under Federal Decree Law No. 41 of 2022. Available to non-Muslims — allows election of home-country law instead of Sharia |
| `notes` | `string` | | |
| `marriageRevocation` | `object` | | Whether and how marriage revokes a prior will. For UAE non-Muslim wills registered with DIFC or ADGM, marriage does not automatically revoke the will. Muslim estates are governed by Sharia fara'id regardless of marital status — will limited to 1/3 for non-heirs. |

Also accepts properties whose names match `^x-inherit-[a-z][a-z0-9-]{1,54}$`.
